name: Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A software-based volume rendering technique that renders scalar field data defined on a 3D rectilinear grid (non-uniform spacing in X, Y, Z) using front-to-back alpha compositing. It solves the problem of visualizing space data where grid cells are not uniform cubes by using coordinate arrays for interpolation.
summary: Trilinear interpolation estimates scalar field values at arbitrary points by averaging eight surrounding voxel corners, producing smoother images with fewer aliasing artifacts than nearest-neighbor methods.
